digest.component_or_area: Jira DC capability mapping and environment contract validation
propositions: On-demand CI job boots digest-pinned Jira DC image and inventories issue types, fields, workflows, statuses, priorities, and link types by direct REST interrogation, recording raw request-response pairs as traceable evidence.

Environment contract (which project template yields Epic, field IDs, screen presence, vocabulary matches) must be committed as data and consumed by test-time assertions, never re-derived or discovered at test runtime.

Field-length limits (summary, description, comment, label) are measured empirically at boundary conditions (limit-1/limit/limit+1) with accept-and-truncate cases detected via read-back comparison, not assumed from hardcoded constants.

Workflow transitions must record both transition NAME and destination STATUS name separately, because status-name matching alone misses DC's classical workflows where transition names differ from their destination states.
Link type directionality (blocks vs depends_on, inward vs outward name) requires end-to-end write-and-read-back experiment on both sides, not name-only presence checking.

Map staleness is checkable via digest provenance: reported image digest is derived from Dockerfile FROM line and asserted against it, so re-pins surface as data conflicts until the map is regenerated.
